why: Measured on 2 October 2026 on dev at fb8abba with no change applied, by lane F of the server split (PRDCT-3154): the baseline run on a laptop (1797 passed, 25 failed) and the first CI run on macos-latest (1797 passed, 28 failed), 15 failures in common. `specs` lists the checks that failed on both, by name: deterministic on dev, cause not investigated by that lane. `unstable` lists the specs that crashed before finishing on both (a crash can never be a known check: it would hide every regression before it) and the specs whose failures differed between the two machines or between two runs on one; their results are counted and printed as UNSTABLE and are not a gate until the spec is fixed (PRDCT-1762 names the boot race behind several of them). A listed check that passes, or an unstable spec that passes in full, is reported by run.mjs so this file shrinks. On 5 October 2026 (lane F round 3) empty-group and hidden-session-restore joined the unstable specs: they fail on both machines with the same boot-race shape (a group created through MCP in the first seconds after the page loads is never drawn: at 2 s it is not, at 3 s it is, in both modes; whether the boot restore wipes it or it is never added was not established, PRDCT-1762), in-process and attached alike, and pass with a 12 s settle instead of 4 s; measured under a load average of 70 to 100. On 7 October 2026 (lane B of wave 2, PRDCT-3240) multi-window-migration joined the unstable specs: its four app-side checks (the two workspaces’ group lists, the group count, the four seeded survivors adopted) failed three times on ee325bc on 6 October, every time with three suites running on the machine, and the spec passed 21 of 21 run alone on lane A’s bare 031afc9, on 61d3641, on b85664f and on ee325bc at load 20, while the verifier of the same lane, run alone on 5bc4efe at load 58 to 104, got 4 checks red then 1, and 1 on 031afc9 bare; the same boot-race shape as the two specs above (the restore and the adoption in the first seconds after boot, PRDCT-1762). On 8 October 2026 (lane C of wave 3, PRDCT-3293, the sessions on the separate server) launcher joined the unstable specs for the attached mode: its two checks after a launch (the terminal's tab drawn at the workspace root, the remembered agent after a restart) went red in two full attached runs at load averages above 60 and passed 13 of 13 alone and 35 of 35 beside its predecessor at load 20, on ce071a3; the same boot-race shape as the specs above, the window reading its first answers before the attached server is announced. On 10 October 2026 (lane A of wave 4, PRDCT-1762) the harness started waiting on the window's boot mark instead of a fixed 4 s, and empty-group, hidden-session-restore, launcher, multi-window-core, multi-window-migration and multi-window-move passed in full in both modes on the first run of the fixed harness (381 passed, in-process and attached alike), so they left this list; group-dissolve, multi-window-routing and codex-chat-tab-restore still failed the same checks in both modes on that run and stay until they are understood. The same day agent-updates joined the unstable specs on lane B's word: pinned in-process, it ran to completion in lane B's full attached suite on a8bc31e with 'MCP openSession failed: Unknown Claude account Work. Available: Default', reproduced 3 of 3 on a8bc31e and 2 of 3 on bare dev a1e5956 by its verifier, and passed 27 of 27 alone on bare dev; the miss is the reloaded window's account store, whose boot read falls to the Default alone when it fails and whose change subscription is bound after that read (claude-profile-store.ts, loadClaudeProfiles), the boot-race shape of PRDCT-1762, in no lane's diff. group-view-start passed in full in both modes in lane A's full suites on be930bb (in-process and attached, 10 October 2026) and left the list; agent-updates passed in full attached and not in-process the same day, and stays. On 10 October 2026 the compact view was removed (2.2): chat-draft-plugin-toggle and plugin-views still drove it and asserted a picker without the Terminal view; rewritten onto the Terminal view, both passed in full in both modes, so they left this list. On 8 November 2026 (lane B of the follow-up wave, PRDCT-4172) the nine spec files red on bare dev at 8824855b and absent from this file were re-measured (170 passed, 29 failed in the nine, in-process) and settled one by one. Corrected in the test folder, nothing to list: chat-draft-plugin-toggle (the view menu item is called Enclave since fcc38c0c), settings-attached (the app icon is this shell's own since 4dee132b, so its write is accepted while attached), mcp-served-tools (a served open folds the new tab under its caller only when the call passes attachToParent, opt-in since 7ccde5fb; the spec predates that and never asked; the lane's verifier found it, PRDCT-4183 records the re-scope), live-chat-restore and restore-timing (their seeded workspace lacked the profileFile and createdAt fields the registry schema requires, and their app inherited the suite's own Clave tab id, so the app's Codex run for itself counted as a session's start). Named here, each under a task in `tasks`: announcement-disclosure and sidebar-whats-new fail one check each, the precondition that help/whats-new.json carries a note for the version the app runs (dev runs 2.4.0, the newest note is 2.0.0, so the card never shows; the rest of each spec runs, PRDCT-4182); triage-snapshot is unstable, its `[in-process] the record files are unchanged, the planted ones included` red in some runs and green in others on the same tree (the planted malformed record gone after a prepare, in-process only, PRDCT-4184); triage-ui crashes at its support-conversation wait on a refused account and is unstable until it runs to its end (PRDCT-4185); restore-timing is unstable on its 2000 ms budget alone, red in 3 of 5 runs on a Mac running two other suites (3220, 3971 and 6121 ms against 1926 and 1966 ms), every other check green (PRDCT-4187). The same lane's two full runs (196 specs, in-process, on 8824855b with no product change) found three more files red both times and running to their end, listed here by check: plugin-surfaces (`and the panel holds the app’s own tabs and the bundled GitHub panel’s`, `the panel contributes a tab, titled and iconed from the manifest`; PRDCT-3520, older than this lane), chat-pane-search (`and it is on screen`) and sidebar-foot (its six fullscreen checks), the last two under PRDCT-4188, cause not investigated by this lane; chat-tab-delivery and restore-groups-and-dead-records failed once and passed alone, load, not listed.
